meanings.tr: daldan dala atlayan, dağınık; uzun ve düzensiz
meanings.en: lengthy and confused, lacking clear structure
meanings.exampleEn: He gave a long, rambling speech that nobody could follow.
meanings.exampleTr: Kimsenin takip edemediği uzun, dağınık bir konuşma yaptı.

meanings.en: a state of shame or loss of honor
meanings.exampleEn: His cowardice brought dishonor to the entire family.
meanings.exampleTr: Korkaklığı tüm aileye utanç getirdi.

meanings.en: used to introduce a contrasting statement
meanings.exampleEn: I wanted to go, but I was too tired.
meanings.exampleTr: Gitmek istedim ama çok yorgundum.

meanings.en: not belonging to or characteristic of humans
meanings.exampleEn: The study focused on nonhuman primates such as chimpanzees.
meanings.exampleTr: Çalışma, şempanze gibi insan dışı primatlara odaklandı.

meanings.en: an animal hunted by another for food
meanings.exampleEn: The lion stalked its prey through the tall grass.
meanings.exampleTr: Aslan uzun otların arasında avını sessizce takip etti.

meanings.en: not allowed by law; illegal
meanings.exampleEn: The court ruled that the search was unlawful.
meanings.exampleTr: Mahkeme, aramanın yasadışı olduğuna hükmetti.

meanings.en: unable to rest or relax; uneasy
meanings.exampleEn: The children grew restless during the long flight.
meanings.exampleTr: Çocuklar uzun uçuş sırasında huzursuzlandı.

meanings.en: the quality of having little significance
meanings.exampleEn: He dismissed the matter, stressing its complete unimportance.
meanings.exampleTr: Konunun tamamen önemsizliğini vurgulayarak meseleyi geçiştirdi.

meanings.en: not able to be reached or achieved
meanings.exampleEn: For many, owning a home in the city feels unattainable.
meanings.exampleTr: Birçokları için şehirde ev sahibi olmak ulaşılamaz görünüyor.

meanings.en: the right or ability to govern oneself
meanings.exampleEn: The region was granted greater autonomy after the agreement.
meanings.exampleTr: Bölgeye anlaşmadan sonra daha geniş özerklik verildi.

meanings.en: the state of relying on something or someone
meanings.exampleEn: The country's dependence on imported oil is a serious concern.
meanings.exampleTr: Ülkenin ithal petrole bağımlılığı ciddi bir endişe kaynağı.

meanings.en: the quality of being intelligent or skilful
meanings.exampleEn: Her cleverness in solving the puzzle impressed everyone.
meanings.exampleTr: Bulmacayı çözmedeki zekiliği herkesi etkiledi.

meanings.en: intelligence or mental ability
meanings.exampleEn: You need brains as well as luck to win this game.
meanings.exampleTr: Bu oyunu kazanmak için şansın yanı sıra akıl da gerekir.

meanings.en: behavior showing a lack of intelligence
meanings.exampleEn: It was sheer stupidity to drive so fast in the fog.
meanings.exampleTr: Sisli havada bu kadar hızlı araba sürmek tam bir aptallıktı.

meanings.en: to plan or invent by careful thought
meanings.exampleEn: They devised a clever scheme to raise money for the school.
meanings.exampleTr: Okul için para toplamak amacıyla akıllıca bir plan tasarladılar.

meanings.en: the use of computers to store and process data
meanings.exampleEn: She works in information technology, managing the company's networks.
meanings.exampleTr: Şirketin ağlarını yöneterek bilgi teknolojisi alanında çalışıyor.

meanings.en: a joke; or something put in the mouth to prevent speech
meanings.exampleEn: The comedian opened his act with a hilarious gag.
meanings.exampleTr: Komedyen gösterisine komik bir şakayla başladı.

meanings.en: comparative of young; less old
meanings.exampleEn: My younger brother is still in primary school.
meanings.exampleTr: Küçük kardeşim hâlâ ilkokulda.

meanings.en: a field of activity or a kingdom
meanings.exampleEn: Her discovery opened up a whole new realm of research.
meanings.exampleTr: Keşfi, tamamen yeni bir araştırma alanı açtı.

meanings.en: a portable lamp with a protective case
meanings.exampleEn: They lit a lantern to find their way through the dark cave.
meanings.exampleTr: Karanlık mağarada yollarını bulmak için bir fener yaktılar.

meanings.en: an unbroken wide view of a surrounding area
meanings.exampleEn: From the summit we enjoyed a stunning panorama of the valley.
meanings.exampleTr: Zirveden vadinin muhteşem bir panoramasının keyfini çıkardık.

meanings.en: superlative of new; most recent
meanings.exampleEn: This is the newest model in their smartphone range.
meanings.exampleTr: Bu, akıllı telefon serilerindeki en yeni model.

meanings.en: the latest in a series of things
meanings.exampleEn: Her most recent novel became an instant bestseller.
meanings.exampleTr: En son romanı bir anda çok satan oldu.

meanings.en: superlative of old; greatest in age
meanings.exampleEn: She is the oldest of five sisters.
meanings.exampleTr: Beş kız kardeşin en büyüğü o.

meanings.en: a written law passed by a legislative body
meanings.exampleEn: The new statute makes it illegal to text while driving.
meanings.exampleTr: Yeni yasa, araç kullanırken mesaj yazmayı yasadışı kılıyor.

meanings.en: a lawyer qualified to represent clients in court
meanings.exampleEn: The defendant hired a skilled attorney for the trial.
meanings.exampleTr: Sanık, dava için yetenekli bir avukat tuttu.

meanings.en: a lawyer who advises clients and prepares legal documents
meanings.exampleEn: We consulted a solicitor before signing the contract.
meanings.exampleTr: Sözleşmeyi imzalamadan önce bir avukata danıştık.

meanings.en: the state of doing nothing or being inactive
meanings.exampleEn: He spent the summer in pure idleness, doing nothing at all.
meanings.exampleTr: Yazı tam bir aylaklık içinde, hiçbir şey yapmadan geçirdi.

meanings.en: reluctance to work or make an effort; laziness
meanings.exampleEn: His sloth prevented him from finishing the project on time.
meanings.exampleTr: Tembelliği, projeyi zamanında bitirmesini engelledi.

meanings.en: effort and labour put into a task
meanings.exampleEn: Her success was the result of years of hard work.
meanings.exampleTr: Başarısı, yıllarca süren sıkı çalışmanın sonucuydu.

meanings.en: time when you are not working or busy
meanings.exampleEn: In my free time I like to read and go hiking.
meanings.exampleTr: Boş zamanlarımda kitap okumayı ve yürüyüşe çıkmayı severim.

meanings.en: a fruit such as orange, lemon or lime
meanings.exampleEn: Citrus fruits are an excellent source of vitamin C.
meanings.exampleTr: Turunçgiller mükemmel bir C vitamini kaynağıdır.

meanings.en: a smaller number of (countable things)
meanings.exampleEn: There were fewer people at the meeting than expected.
meanings.exampleTr: Toplantıda beklenenden daha az insan vardı.

meanings.en: the typical manner in which a person or group lives
meanings.exampleEn: Farming is not just a job for them; it's a way of life.
meanings.exampleTr: Çiftçilik onlar için sadece bir iş değil; bir yaşam biçimi.

meanings.en: a metric unit of volume equal to 1000 millilitres
meanings.exampleEn: Please buy two litres of milk on your way home.
meanings.exampleTr: Eve dönerken lütfen iki litre süt al.

meanings.en: full of energy, life or bright colour
meanings.exampleEn: The city has a vibrant nightlife full of music and dancing.
meanings.exampleTr: Şehir, müzik ve dansla dolu canlı bir gece hayatına sahip.

meanings.en: goods carried by a ship, plane or vehicle
meanings.exampleEn: The ship was carrying a cargo of grain to Africa.
meanings.exampleTr: Gemi Afrika'ya bir tahıl yükü taşıyordu.

meanings.en: a fastening for a door or gate
meanings.exampleEn: She lifted the latch and pushed the gate open.
meanings.exampleTr: Mandalı kaldırdı ve kapıyı iterek açtı.

meanings.en: not following the rules of logic or reason
meanings.exampleEn: It would be illogical to sell the car and then need a ride everywhere.
meanings.exampleTr: Arabayı satıp sonra her yere taşınmaya ihtiyaç duymak mantıksız olurdu.

meanings.en: loose or not taut; lacking activity
meanings.exampleEn: The rope hung slack between the two posts.
meanings.exampleTr: İp iki direk arasında gevşek bir şekilde sarkıyordu.

meanings.en: loose and hanging in folds, especially clothing
meanings.exampleEn: He wore baggy jeans that were far too big for him.
meanings.exampleTr: Kendisine fazlasıyla büyük olan bol bir kot pantolon giymişti.

meanings.en: past tense of mislay; put something where it cannot be found
meanings.exampleEn: I seem to have mislaid my keys somewhere in the house.
meanings.exampleTr: Anahtarlarımı evde bir yere koyup kaybetmiş gibiyim.

meanings.en: a person who strongly dislikes or criticizes others
meanings.exampleEn: Despite the haters, she kept posting her music online.
meanings.exampleTr: Kötüleyenlere rağmen müziğini internette paylaşmaya devam etti.

meanings.en: in an unfortunate way; unfortunately
meanings.exampleEn: Unluckily, it started raining just as we left the house.
meanings.exampleTr: Ne yazık ki, tam evden çıkarken yağmur başladı.

meanings.en: placed under a magic spell; delighted
meanings.exampleEn: The children believed the old forest was enchanted.
meanings.exampleTr: Çocuklar eski ormanın büyülü olduğuna inanıyordu.

meanings.en: the first course of a meal
meanings.exampleEn: For a starter, I'll have the tomato soup.
meanings.exampleTr: Başlangıç olarak domates çorbası alacağım.

meanings.en: mainly; for the most part
meanings.exampleEn: The town is known chiefly for its ancient castle.
meanings.exampleTr: Kasaba başlıca antik kalesiyle tanınır.

meanings.en: products used to improve the appearance of the body
meanings.exampleEn: She spends a fortune on cosmetics and skincare.
meanings.exampleTr: Kozmetik ürünlere ve cilt bakımına bir servet harcıyor.

meanings.en: a large group of shops in one building or area
meanings.exampleEn: We met our friends at the new shopping center downtown.
meanings.exampleTr: Arkadaşlarımızla şehir merkezindeki yeni alışveriş merkezinde buluştuk.

meanings.en: a large group of shops in one building or area
meanings.exampleEn: The new shopping centre has over a hundred stores.
meanings.exampleTr: Yeni alışveriş merkezinde yüzden fazla mağaza var.

meanings.en: to manage something badly or carelessly
meanings.exampleEn: The directors were accused of mismanaging the company's funds.
meanings.exampleTr: Yöneticiler şirketin fonlarını kötü yönetmekle suçlandı.

meanings.en: not married; single
meanings.exampleEn: At the time of the census he was still unmarried.
meanings.exampleTr: Nüfus sayımı sırasında hâlâ bekardı.

meanings.en: magnificent; very impressive or excellent
meanings.exampleEn: We had a splendid view of the mountains from the hotel.
meanings.exampleTr: Otelden dağların muhteşem bir manzarasını gördük.

meanings.en: abbreviation for minute or minimum
meanings.exampleEn: The recipe says to bake the cake for 30 min.
meanings.exampleTr: Tarif, keki 30 dakika pişirmeyi söylüyor.

meanings.en: relating to medical treatment; or coldly detached
meanings.exampleEn: The new drug is currently undergoing clinical trials.
meanings.exampleTr: Yeni ilaç şu anda klinik denemelerden geçiyor.

meanings.en: a person who does not belong to a group or organization
meanings.exampleEn: Non-members must pay an entrance fee to use the gym.
meanings.exampleTr: Üye olmayanlar spor salonunu kullanmak için giriş ücreti ödemelidir.

meanings.en: a metric unit of length equal to 100 centimetres
meanings.exampleEn: The swimming pool is fifty metres long.
meanings.exampleTr: Yüzme havuzu elli metre uzunluğunda.

meanings.tr: saat on iki (öğlen ya da gece yarısı)
meanings.en: the hour of midday or midnight
meanings.exampleEn: The meeting starts at twelve o'clock sharp.
meanings.exampleTr: Toplantı tam saat on ikide başlıyor.

meanings.en: relating to war or the armed forces
meanings.exampleEn: The country was placed under martial law during the crisis.
meanings.exampleTr: Ülke kriz sırasında sıkıyönetim (askeri yönetim) altına alındı.

meanings.en: a person not in the armed forces or police
meanings.exampleEn: Many civilians were forced to flee the war zone.
meanings.exampleTr: Birçok sivil, savaş bölgesinden kaçmak zorunda kaldı.

meanings.en: water containing bubbles of carbon dioxide
meanings.exampleEn: Would you like still or sparkling water with your meal?
meanings.exampleTr: Yemeğinizle sade su mu yoksa maden suyu mu istersiniz?

meanings.en: water that comes from a tap in a building
meanings.exampleEn: In this city the tap water is perfectly safe to drink.
meanings.exampleTr: Bu şehirde musluk suyu içmek için tamamen güvenli.

meanings.en: a mirror (old-fashioned term)
meanings.exampleEn: She gazed at her reflection in the old looking glass.
meanings.exampleTr: Eski aynadaki yansımasına baktı.

meanings.en: able to be easily carried or moved
meanings.exampleEn: We took a portable speaker to the beach.
meanings.exampleTr: Plaja taşınabilir bir hoparlör götürdük.

meanings.en: able to be moved from one place to another
meanings.exampleEn: The shelves are movable, so you can rearrange the room.
meanings.exampleTr: Raflar hareket ettirilebilir, böylece odayı yeniden düzenleyebilirsin.

meanings.en: not moving; standing still
meanings.exampleEn: The car remained stationary at the red light.
meanings.exampleTr: Araba kırmızı ışıkta hareketsiz kaldı.

meanings.en: the quality of being amusing or comic
meanings.exampleEn: She has a great sense of humour and makes everyone laugh.
meanings.exampleTr: Harika bir espri anlayışı var ve herkesi güldürüyor.

meanings.en: to fail to catch, hit, or be present for something
meanings.exampleEn: Hurry up, or we'll miss the last train home.
meanings.exampleTr: Acele et, yoksa eve giden son treni kaçıracağız.

meanings.en: the killing of one person by another
meanings.exampleEn: The detective was assigned to investigate the homicide.
meanings.exampleTr: Dedektif, cinayeti soruşturmakla görevlendirildi.

meanings.en: an organism such as a mould, mushroom or mildew
meanings.exampleEn: A strange fungus was growing on the damp bathroom wall.
meanings.exampleTr: Nemli banyo duvarında garip bir mantar büyüyordu.
